# Pull request

## Description

Include a concise summary of the change and what problem it solves.

## Responsibility Checklist

By submitting this Pull Request, I confirm:

- [ ] I verified behavior locally and ran tests.
- [ ] I reviewed chatbot/automation output and take full ownership.
- [ ] I kept scope focused and documented non-obvious decisions.
- [ ] I did not introduce security regressions or leak sensitive data.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
